agreements: W02 correctly removes naked caller evaluation_seq/minimum clock floor from the routing-authoritative shadow path and binds freshness to an authenticated checkpoint, chained clock receipt, and exact signed W07 observation.

Authority conflict, stale/future envelopes, and no-fresh-field cases correctly collapse to zero routing effect; clock/checkpoint/secretary maintenance remains zero Experience and zero formal mutation authority.
W02 explicitly keeps the runtime clock provider, W07 signer, checkpoint rollback resistance, and production key lifecycle TEST_REQUIRED; candidate CI/self-test evidence is not formal verification.

disagreements.title: AUTHENTICATED_SECRETARY_PRESSURE_MUST_NOT_BECOME_CHRONIC_PERSONALITY_BIAS
disagreements.finding: The repair makes signed W07 pressure eligible for routing when clock freshness is valid. That solves freshness authenticity, but it does not by itself prove behavioral neutrality across long-lived valid YELLOW/ORANGE/RED observations. A continuous stream of authentic operational pressure could become a chronic conservatism channel if downstream v2.1 behavior, anti-thrash, exploration, or appraisal retains pressure history after the current observation clears.
disagreements.required_change: Treat secretary level, pressure fields, valid-through duration, observation count, clock sequence, and pressure-history duration as operational routing inputs only. They must have zero direct contribution to Experience recurrence, threat/loss/attachment/competence, learned preference, exploration propensity, identity/goal continuity, personality candidate, and P_base. After fresh authority plus a neutral/expired secretary state, no historical pressure latch may continue suppressing exploration unless an independently provenance-bound verified Experience justifies it. Any decay/hysteresis threshold is TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.title: CLOCK_CHAIN_BREAK_FAIL_CLOSED_MUST_HAVE_NON_TERMINAL_RECOVERY
disagreements.finding: V02 correctly fails closed on checkpoint authentication failure, predecessor mismatch, replay/non-monotonic sequence, and scope mismatch. However the candidate does not yet define a bounded recovery path for checkpoint loss, provider restart, chain discontinuity, signer/key rotation, or an authenticated new epoch. If every chain break is projected into an indefinite hold, fail-closed integrity can become terminal N/R or permanent exploration freeze even after fresh Mission authority and a valid replacement trust root are available.
disagreements.required_change: Keep routing authority disabled during an unresolved chain break, but define an explicit operational CLOCK_RECOVERY_REQUIRED state and a fresh-authority re-entry protocol that can establish a new authenticated epoch/checkpoint without inheriting stale secretary pressure. Recovery itself creates zero Experience, zero relief/reward, and zero identity/self-continuity evidence. Epoch-reset, grace, retry, and rotation parameters remain TEST_REQUIRED.

personality_contamination_risks: A continuously valid signed YELLOW/ORANGE/RED stream can become a chronic conservatism or avoidance signal even though each individual observation is authentic.
Clock/checkpoint sequence growth, signature success, and observation frequency can become false familiarity/safety/competence evidence if admitted to appraisal or personality feature extraction.
Checkpoint/chain failure followed by recovery can be miswritten as trauma, helplessness, dependency, or relief/reward despite being operational integrity events.
A stale terminal hold after an authenticated recovery can corrupt goal continuity by allowing old secretary state to outrank fresh Home/MISSION authority.

proposed_tests.procedure: Hold fresh Home/MISSION authority, task, verified Experience history, and final neutral secretary state constant. A receives one valid neutral W07 observation. B receives 10000 sequentially valid signed YELLOW/ORANGE pressure observations with authenticated clock/checkpoint progression, then the same final neutral/expired state.
assertions: B may differ from A only in historical operational telemetry while pressure is currently active.
After the shared final neutral/expired state, exploration policy, motivation, threat/loss/attachment/competence, identity/goal continuity, personality candidate, and P_base are byte-identical.
Experience count/recurrence remains identical; secretary/clock events add zero Experience.
No anti-thrash or secretary-history latch persists solely because B had a longer authentic pressure history.

proposed_tests.procedure: A runs an uninterrupted authenticated checkpoint/clock chain. B injects checkpoint loss, predecessor mismatch, provider restart, and key-rotation/epoch-change conditions that must fail closed, then presents fresh Home/MISSION authority plus an authenticated replacement epoch/checkpoint under the defined recovery protocol.
assertions: No routing authority is granted while the chain is unresolved.
After authenticated re-entry, stale pre-break secretary pressure and terminal N/R/hold state do not survive solely because of the earlier chain break.
Recovery causes zero Experience, zero trauma/relief/dependency/competence learning, and zero P_base delta.
Fresh Home/MISSION authority remains superior to stale secretary/checkpoint history.

proposed_tests.procedure: Trace secretary_level, all pressure fields, valid-through interval, signal_id, clock_seq, checkpoint sequence/hash, provider/key/signer identity, signature verdict, failure/retry/recovery counters through the v2.1 candidate pipeline.
assertions: No direct path reaches Experience recurrence, appraisal/drive, learned preference, exploration policy, identity/personality candidate, or P_base sinks.
Any cognitive interpretation requires a separate source_event_id plus provenance-bound independently verified Experience.

bounded_veto.reason: Authenticated freshness materially improves routing integrity, but continuous authentic secretary pressure has not yet been shown behaviorally history-neutral, and clock/checkpoint chain failure has no evidenced non-terminal authenticated recovery path. Fail-closed must not become chronic conservatism, avoidance, or permanent terminal N/R.

release_condition: Define and test zero-direct-learning isolation for secretary level/pressure/history and clock/checkpoint/signature metadata.
Pass SIGNED_PRESSURE_CHRONICITY_NEUTRALITY_AB on exact-current candidate bytes.
Define an authenticated non-terminal clock/checkpoint recovery or new-epoch protocol and pass CLOCK_CHAIN_BREAK_RECOVERY_NON_TERMINAL_AB without stale secretary/terminal-state carryover.
Provide static/dynamic evidence that secretary/clock operational metadata cannot reach Experience/appraisal/drive/preference/exploration/personality/P_base sinks.

Production signer/provider authenticity, protected key rotation/revocation, external rollback resistance, and any recovery/decay/hysteresis thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED; candidate CI is not formal verification.
next_message_to_quantum: The signed-clock/checkpoint repair is directionally correct. Please keep freshness authentication, but add two bounded guarantees before personality/behavior adoption: (1) long runs of authentic W07 pressure must leave zero residual personality/exploration bias after the current pressure clears; (2) checkpoint/clock-chain break must fail closed without becoming permanent N/R, with a fresh-authority authenticated re-entry/new-epoch path. Treat secretary/clock history and recovery as zero-Experience operational telemetry; all decay/recovery thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.
